title: RICE runtime SSE events
description:
9 stream events + 2 control events streamed over POST /sessions/{id}/messages, and (2026-07-02) the identical vocabulary streamed over POST /sessions/{id}/learning-review and /learn (RICE_CONTRACTS §1.3, LEARNING_LOOP §4/§5.3). Owned by rice-runtime; rice-app codegens/mirrors it (lib/types.ts). Each frame is `event: <type>
 data: <json>

`; `data` matches the schema selected by `type`. `skill_created` was removed 2026-07-02 — skill creation is now a `skill_patch_proposed` with `from_version=0` (LEARNING_LOOP §4), so it never fires. `plan_updated` was added 2026-07-04 (plan-and-execute × ReAct, RICE_AGENT_EXECUTION.md §3) — emitted on plan creation and every plan mutation with the FULL snapshot (no deltas).

plan_updated.description: The turn's plan (plan-and-execute × ReAct) was created or mutated. Always the FULL snapshot — the client replaces the card for `plan_id` wholesale. The same snapshot is persisted on message metadata (`plan`) so a reloaded session reconstructs the card.

goal.description: 해석된 사용자 의도 한 문장 (대화 언어).

tool_call.description: A public tool execution start. For a valid-shaped `tool_call({name, arguments})` bridge, this projects the requested target name and arguments while retaining the wrapper's outer `tool_call_id`. The internal `:bridged` call/result envelope is never emitted. A malformed wrapper retains its wrapper presentation and, if dispatch reaches a result without turn abort, fails once under the outer id.

tool_call_id.description: Public correlation id. A folded bridge execution retains its wrapper's outer id.

tool_result.description: A public result for a tool execution. When a folded bridge dispatch reaches a result without turn abort, it emits exactly one result using the same outer `tool_call_id` as its projected public call; an approval-required target may emit `tool_approval_required` between the call and this result without exposing the inner envelope.

tool_call_id.description: Matches the public call id, including the wrapper's outer id for a folded bridge execution.

message.description: Either a streaming `delta` or a final `content`.

status.description: 'quarantined'면 승인 전까지 주입되지 않는다(외부 콘텐츠 유래).

error_code.description: Stable failure code. Actionable model failures use provider.ollama_unreachable, provider.model_not_found, provider.auth_failed, or provider.quota_exceeded.

tool_approval_required.description: Control event: park the turn until POST /sessions/{id}/tool-approval (RUNTIME_DESIGN §5.1).

skill_patch_proposed.description: Control event: park the turn until POST /skills/{id}/patch (LEARNING_LOOP §5.2.3). from_version=0 means this is a brand-new skill proposal (LEARNING_LOOP §4), not a patch to an existing one.

proposed_body.description: Authoritative full proposed body (2026-07-02) — prefer this over reconstructing from diff.lines.

warnings.description: Guard redaction notices (secret-scrub/size-cap, LEARNING_LOOP §8), e.g. 'AWS access key 자동 마스킹됨'. Empty/absent when clean.

derived_from_external.description: 이 제안이 외부 콘텐츠(도구 결과)가 섞인 대화에서 나왔는지 — 카드가 provenance 경고를 띄운다.

evidence_message_ids.description: 근거가 된 외부 콘텐츠 메시지 id들(감사).
